scope: directory transfer takes over an identical snapshot leaf produced by another asset; supersede old asset ownership
allowed: target leaf registered by any asset, actual content equal to its registered snapshot
refused: registered snapshot drifted (same asset or other asset)

ownership.old_managed_file: removed after exact compare inside the publish transaction
ownership.old_history: independent success record kept; later deletion refuses on snapshot mismatch
ownership.new_leaf: owned by the directory receipt shared subset

cases: takeover another asset's leaf (real single-file then directory import)
append and native softlink append unchanged
